image_generation_request.prompt: A fossilized Triceratops skull is lying on the ground, clearly showing damage from a fight with a T-Rex. A large bite mark has removed a significant section of the frill, extending from the edge. The bone around the bite mark shows signs of ancient trauma and breakage. The three horns remain visible on the skull.  Oddly, there are no other bones from this Triceratops skeleton nearby as if scavengers successfully ate everything else.   The fossil is embedded in a landscape reminiscent of the LANCE_HELL_CREEK (Late Cretaceous) formation, with dry, sandy ground, sparse vegetation, and a clear sky.   A caption in bright red 3D mixed case letters reads, Dino Bones!
